Subject: Post-demo follow-up: DPA routing preference, SCC module choice & VSQ initiation (FintraHealth)

Hi Elena — great to meet you and the FintraHealth team on the demo this morning. Thanks for the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on security and contracting items: 

What we heard from Fintra on the call:
- You will be the data controller for customer data; FintraHealth expects Redwood to operate as a data processor for the integration.
- You want to review a DPA and pick the SCC module that matches your legal routing.
- You also asked about SOC 2 status, HIPAA/BAA coverage, and typical security evidence we can provide.

Action items we propose (please confirm):
1) Elena / procurement: send us your DPA and vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) so we can start routing internally.
2) Redwood security: we will propose the SCC module we recommend (controller -> processor) and provide the VSQ response draft.
3) Redwood legal: we can produce a DPA draft that mirrors the SCC module selection and share a DocuSign link for signature.
4) Security evidence: we will surface SOC 2 status (report or roadmap), encryption, retention guardrails, KMS integration details, and any HIPAA BAA info if PHI is in scope.

For transparency: attached is the demo deck we reviewed. We also flagged this as a sales -> legal -> security handoff in HubSpot (link below).

Proposed timeline: if we can get the DPA + VSQ today, Laura (security) will start the VSQ response tomorrow and Marissa (solutions/legal ops) will coordinate contracting. If SOC 2 Type II is required before signing, we can provide our current Type II report (if available) or a SOC 2 progress statement and bridge plan.

Next meeting suggestion: 30-min technical/controls call with your security lead + our Laura next week (availability attached).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(jordan_blake@redwood.com)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the recap and the demo. Quick answers and what we attached: 

1) FintraHealth will act as the controller; Redwood will be a data processor. We will expect a controller->processor DPA and the corresponding SCCs for controller -> processor transfers (Module 2 pattern).

2) Attached are our standard DPA (Fintra_DPA_v1.pdf) and the vendor security questionnaire (Fintra_VSQ.xlsx). Please start the VSQ and return it with any clarifying notes.

3) SOC 2: we understand you asked for a copy. Our compliance team has indicated Redwood has an internal SOC 2 process; please state whether you have a recent Type II or a roadmap/timeline for Type II. If you don’t have Type II today, list compensating controls and estimated delivery quarter.

4) HIPAA: we do process PHI for some customers. Please indicate whether Redwood offers a BAA and what the scope would be.

We’d like to get the VSQ and a draft DPA back within 3 business days so our legal team can review ahead of procurement.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Legal & Privacy
FintraHealth
(elena.ruiz@fintrahealth.com)

Hi Elena — Laura from Security here. Thanks for sending the DPA + VSQ. A few clarifying items from the controls perspective before we fill out the questionnaire: 

Key questions:
- You mentioned controller -> processor SCC routing. Can you confirm you expect the EU Controller -> Processor SCC set (we typically map to the EEA controller->processor module when Fintra is the controller)?
- Please confirm the processing purposes (e.g., user profiles, content indexing, telemetry) and categories of personal data in scope (identifiers, special categories/health data). If PHI is in scope, we will include BAA coverage in our response.

Required evidence we will provide in the VSQ zip:
- Latest SOC 2 report if available OR SOC 2 progress statement + timeline for Type II (we can include evidence of ongoing controls and auditor engagement).
- Encryption at rest & in transit details, including KMS provider and key rotation cadence.
- Data retention controls and configurable retention windows per customer.
- Access control & audit logging details (IAM, SSO, admin audit logs).
- Incident response playbook and contact for security incidents.

I’m attaching a short security evidence checklist to speed validation. If PHI is present, call that out explicitly and we’ll include BAA language/commitments.

Next steps:
- We’ll draft answers to the VSQ and return a redline-friendly DPA draft that aligns with controller -> processor SCC mapping.
- Marissa will coordinate legal touches for any non-standard contract terms.

Laura Bennett
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(laura_bennett@redwood.com)

Laura / Jordan — thanks for the quick turn. A couple clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- Confirmed: FintraHealth will sign a controller -> processor DPA. We typically ask vendors to accept the controller->processor SCC module for EU transfers (Module 2 mapping in our intake). Please propose the clause language that maps your DPA to that SCC set.

- SOC 2: our policy is to require a SOC 2 Type II within 6 months of go-live or, if unavailable, a Type I plus an agreed remediation/attestation timeline. If Redwood is still in progress for Type II, please provide a short timeline and interim controls evidence.

- HIPAA: Fintra uses PHI in a small subset of integration flows. We will need a BAA addendum — if you already have a BAA template, please attach or confirm you can include BAA language in the DPA.

- VSQ: please return the completed VSQ and any supporting docs to procurement@fintrahealth.com. We will route to our security team for review.

Procurement will wait for Redwood’s draft DPA + VSQ answers. Once we have those, we’ll aim to do an initial review within 3 business days and schedule a follow-up technical call with your security team.

Thanks,
FintraHealth Procurement
(procurement@fintrahealth.com)
